arabic text: AY BIBI BANIYE AZAA, PEGHAAM KARBALA TERA, JISNE SUNA YAHI KAHA
english translation text: O YOU WHO STARTED AZADARI,\nWHOEVER HEARD YOUR MESSAGE ABOUT KARBALA, SAID THIS,

arabic text: TEGH KHUTBO KI BARSARE DARBAAR, JAISE CHALTI HO HAIDERI TALWAAR, KAT KE GHIRTE THE ZALIMO KE JIGAR, JANG-E-KHAIBER THI YA TERI LALKAAR
english translation text: THE EFFECT OF YOUR SERMONS IN THE COURT OF YAZID WAS LIKE THE SWORD OF ALI (A.S.) IN THE BATTLEFIELD,\nYOUR SERMONS WOULD CUT UP THE ENEMY FROM INSIDE

arabic text: AY BIBI BANIYE AZAA, DINE RASOOL BACH GAYA, QURAN KI THI YE SADAA
english translation text: O YOU WHO STARTED AZADARI,\nTHE RELIGION OF THE PROPHET (PBUH) HAS BEEN SAVED,\nTHIS IS WHAT THE QURAN IS SAYING,

arabic text: YAAD ATA HAI SHAAM KA MANZAR, BIBI SARPE TERE NA THI CHADAR, HAR TARAF PATHARO KI BAARISH THI, TERI POSHAAAK THI LAHU ME TAR
english translation text: WE REMEMBER THOSE SCENES OF SHAAM, WHEN YOU WERE WITHOUT YOUR VEIL,\nSTONES WERE BEING PELTED FROM EVERY DIRECTION, YOUR CLOTHES WERE SOAKED IN BLOOD

arabic text: AY BIBI BANIYE AZAA, SADMA THA YE BOHOT BARAA, ROYA SARE SHAHE HUDAA
english translation text: O YOU WHO STARTED AZADARI,\nTHIS WAS A HUGE CALAMITY, EVEN THE HEAD OF IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S.) WEPT

arabic text: TUNE BACHO KI DI HAI QURBANI, HAYE RE TERA ZOKH IMAANI, PYAASE BHAYI KI YAAD ME TUNE, KHUN BAHAYA HAI ANKHE KA PAANI
english translation text: YOU SACRIFICED YOUR SONS, THIS WAS YOUR HEART’S DESIRE,\nWHEN YOU REMEMBERED YOUR BROTHER’S THIRST, YOU CRIED BLOOD INSTEAD OF TEARS

arabic text: AY BIBI BANIYE AZAA, YE ZABTA HOSLA TERA, NEZE PE SER PUKAARTA
english translation text: O YOU WHO STARTED AZADARI,\nYOU WERE THE EPITOME OF PATIENCE,\nTHE HEAD ON THE SPEAR IS SAYING,

arabic text: TERE DAR PAR YE ISTIGHASA HAI, JO BHI FARSHE AZA PE ROTA HAI, US PE SAYA KARE TERA GHAZI, WO JO MUSHKIL KUSHA KA BETA HAI
english translation text: WE COME TO YOUR DOOR STEP AND ASK,\nWHOEVER SHEDS TEARS IN A MAJLIS (FARSHE AZA), MAY HAZRAT ABBAS (A.S) PROTECT HIM, WHO IS THE SON OF IMAM ALI (THE SOLVER OF PROBLEMS)

arabic text: KITNE MAKROOZ MATAMI HAI TERE, KARZA TU GHAIB SE ADAA KARDE, BIBI TU TO SAKHI KI BETI HAI, TU TO MUFLIS KO BAADSHAAH KAR DE
english translation text: SOME OF YOUR FOLLOWERS ARE IN DEBT, HELP THEM REPAY THEIR DEBTS,\nO BIBI! YOU’RE THE DAUGHTER OF THE GENEROUS ONE, HELP THOSE WHO ARE IN POVERTY

arabic text: QAID BE JURMA JO HAI MATAMDAAR, MISLE MAZLOOM AABIDE BIMAAR, UNKO AZAADIYO KO TOHFA DE, AAJ TU MISLE HAIDARE KARRAR
english translation text: THOSE FOLLOWERS OF YOURS WHO HAVE BEEN IMPRISONED UNJUSTLY LIKE IMAM SAJJAD (A.S.),\nGRANT THEM THE GIFT OF FREEDOM, TODAY YOU ARE LIKE IMAM ALI (A.S.)

arabic text: TERE BHAYI NE JAISE RAHIB KO, SAAT BETE ATAA KIYE PHIRTO, TU BHI HAMSHEER US SAKHI KI HAI, DEDE AWLAAD CHAHIYE JISKO
english translation text: YOUR BROTHER GRANTED SEVEN SONS TO THE PRIEST,\nYOU ARE THE SISTER OF THAT GENEROUS ONE, SO GRANT CHILDREN TO THOSE WHO DESIRE THEM
